name: 張烔堡
objective:
先修課程：4402014 或負責教授同意
一維及多維穩定態熱傳導及非穩定態熱傳導；對流原理，強迫對流及自然對流經驗和實驗關係式；輻射熱傳遞；凝結與沸騰；熱交換器；熱傳遞中的特殊論題。
Steady-State Conduction-One Dimension, Steady-State Conduction- Multiple Dimensions, Unsteady-State Conduction, Principles of Convection, Empirical and Practical Relations for Forced-Convection Heat Transfer, Natural- Convection Systems, Radiation Heat Transfer, Condensation and Boiling Heat Transfer, Heat Exchangers, Special Topics in Heat Transfer.
schedule:
第 01 週 Introduction to Heat Transfer
第 02 週 Introduction to Conduction
第 03 週 One-Dimensional / Steady-State Conduction without Thermal Energy Generation
第 04 週 One-Dimensional / Steady-State Conduction with Thermal Energy Generation
第 05 週 One-Dimensional / Steady-State Conduction / Extended Surfaces
第 06 週 Steady-State / Multi-Dimensional Conduction / The Heat Equation and Methods of Solution
第 07 週 Steady-State / Multi-Dimensional Conduction / The Heat Equation and Methods of Solution
第 08 週 Steady-State / Multi-Dimensional Conduction / Finite-Difference Equations and Solutions
第 09 週 Midterm Exam
第 10 週 Transient Conduction / The Lumped Capacitance Method
第 11 週 Fundamental Concepts of Convection
第 12 週 Force convection External flow
第 13 週 Force convection External flow
第 14 週 Force convection Internal flow
第 15 週 Force convection Internal flow
第 16 週 Free convection 
第 17 週 Free convection
第 18 週 Final Exam
scorePolicy:
Homework, quiz and Attendance 30%
Midterm Exam 35%
Final Exam 35%
materials: Incropera's Principles of Heat and Mass Transfer, Frank P. Incropera, David P. Dewitt, Theodore L. Bergman, Adrienne S. Lavine, Global Edition, John Wiley & Sons.
consultation: Tuesday and Wednesday, 9 AM to 12 AM @ Integrated Technology Complex Building, Room 113. Available after class or by appointment at other times. No homework assistance by e-mail.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
